verdict.rationale: Homebrew can point at additional package sources through taps. The two-argument `brew tap` form accepts any Git URL, so an organization can host its own formula repository [homebrew-docs-60, homebrew-docs-5]. Taps can also ship their own bottles [homebrew-docs-58], and fully qualified names select formulae from a specific tap with per-item trust [homebrew-docs-61, homebrew-docs-63]. However, the evidence never documents mirror configuration or any scoped, per-source authentication, and a community report notes that hosting a private tap requires running a Git server rather than a simple CDN-backed registry [homebrew-comm-16]. Missing for 10: documented mirror/bottle-domain override, scoped credential or token configuration per tap/registry, independent corroboration of private-registry auth workflows.
